notes.text: Configured stylesheet text, document style and accessible linked stylesheets, and document.adoptedStyleSheets are read in cascade order. Adopted-sheet ordering is verified against Chromium; configured, external, CSSOM mutation, and invalidation behavior is covered by package-contract tests.
Cross-origin or otherwise inaccessible linked stylesheets cannot contribute rules. They are routed through the unsupported CSS policy as an unsupported stylesheet rule. At-rules remain unsupported.
